title: Solid item.. IF only assembly issue was addressed!!
text:
Solid item.. IF only assembly issue was addressed!!. Choosing to use for excess kitchen appliances- I ordered to place at the end of my wall cupboards. This shelving unit is a great size for just such need. It would fit likewise in an end hallway, office, bath or laundry room.. any narrow spot where storage may be sparse!

What I found was the actual shelving platform to set items on requires items with a lot smaller footprint.. I anticipated placing an air fryer, Keurig, electric fry pan, waffle maker one item per shelf and this offered just enough levels to do so. Problem is, shelves were either too skinny, too short.. or else, my item was too overbearing! *keep in mind- whatever you’re placing on this ladder shelf.. think smaller, it will insure both the fit and look is appropriate!! items such as tea pot, mugs, fruit bowl, plant, canisters.. nothing bigger and NO small appliances!

As for construction: this was a big frustration and a cluster of a mess!!! Photos/description online give buyer the confidence this is a reputable item and one expects that would include the attention when it comes to instructions, labeling, etc. to assemble the product.. Well, I was wrong! Yes, all parts and hardware are included but, it was frustrating at best to guess and “mistake” your way through the build.. To ultimately be forcing things to fit- and we found in the end, it was the only way to assemble this!! NOTE TO SELLER: This could be easily rectified with a simple sticker/label of parts!! Photos included with instructions don’t fix the issue either… not unless you labeled parts.

Final product: IF.. you can complete this wider base provides a sturdy enough stance to create a stable shelving unit. Overall, this is not an investment piece of furniture but more in line with an add-on solution.. at $50, this could be an asset that could go to work and provide a solution for the buyer.. If the headache of building was addressed! Hoping this info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know.
